sentences.en: It is bad for people not to have aspirations.
sentences.zh: 没有志向对人来说是不好的。

sentences.en: He is extremely pessimistic and has no aspirations.
sentences.zh: 他极其悲观，没有任何志向。

sentences.en: She has aspirations to become an interior decorator.
sentences.zh: 她立志成为一名室内设计师。

senses.zh: 吸引术；抽吸；吸气；发送气音

mnemonic: 词根记忆：a（加强）+spir（呼吸）+ ation→看到渴望的东西就呼吸急促→强烈的愿望
